property_summary: For any initialize(...) inputs, the reference contract sets baseToken equal to the provided _baseToken argument (i.e., c.baseToken() == _baseToken); the mutant that assigns baseToken = _nft breaks this by making c.baseToken() != _baseToken for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken to nft (swap), i.e., baseToken = _nft, instead of the provided _baseToken.
